name: Build Linux System Libs

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: basic
            args: ""
          - name: hardsubx
            args: "-hardsubx"
    
    steps:
    - name: Cancel Previous Runs
      uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
      with:
        access_token: ${{ github.token }}

    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        submodules: recursive

    - name: Install System Dependencies

        sudo apt-get update

          libmpg123-dev \
          libwavpack-dev \
          libdvdread-dev \
          libdvdnav-dev \
          libbluray-dev \
          libcdio-paranoia-dev \
          libcdio-cdda-dev \
          libcdio-dev \
          libiso9660-dev \
          libudfread-dev

    - name: Configure Build
      run: |
        mkdir -p build
        cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DWITH_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON ${{ matrix.args }}

    - name: Build
      run: |
        cd build
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Verify Binaries
      run: |
        cd build
        echo "Checking binary linking..."
        ldd ccextractor | grep -E "(libav|libsw|libpostproc|libvpx|libx264|libx265|libmp3lame|libopus|libvorbis|libtheora|libspeex|libwebp|libpng|libjpeg|libtiff|libopenjp2|libfreetype|libharfbuzz|libfribidi|libfontconfig|libx11|libxext|libxrender|libxfixes|libxi|libxrandr|libxinerama|libxcursor|libxss|libxtst|libgtk|libgl|libpulse|libasound|libjack|libsndfile|libsoxr|librubberband|liblilv|libmodplug|libfluidsynth|libgme|libsidplayfp|libopenmpt|libmpg123|libwavpack|libdvdread|libdvdnav|libbluray|libcdio|libiso9660|libudfread)" || true

    - name: Upload Artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.name }}-system-libs
        path: build/ccextractor
        retention-days: 7

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
    - name: Download Artifacts
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
      with:
        pattern: ccextractor-*-system-libs
        merge-multiple: true

    - name: Verify Artifacts Exist
      run: |
        ls -la
        test -f ccextractor && echo "Binary exists" || echo "Binary missing"

    - name: Run Basic Tests
      run: |
        ./ccextractor --help
        echo "Basic functionality test passed"
